verdict.rationale: Superset lets a developer describe a task, pick an agent, and have it start immediately in an isolated worktree and branch. The developer then reviews the agent's changes in a diff viewer and can commit, push and create a PR from there, which covers the end-to-end feature flow. However, the implementation itself is done by third-party CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) that Superset only orchestrates, and nothing in the evidence addresses test writing or running. Missing for 10: any evidence of test authoring or test execution as part of the agent workflow, a first-party implementation capability, and hands-on corroboration of a full feature-plus-tests delivery.
